mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO falling below 100) indicates reduced industrial output, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 4.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market downturn (HOUST falling below 1500 thousand units) signals reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
